propositions: Core reconciler transport parameters must be annotated with TicketTransport type using resolvable import paths (relative imports or TYPE_CHECKING-guarded absolute paths), not the sys.path-shimmed rebar_reconciler module path, to prevent mypy from silently widening annotations to Any under ignore_missing_imports

Opt-in capability members (add_comment, set_relationship, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) must be narrowed via composed capability Protocols at call sites, never added to TicketTransport's body or hidden behind Any casts, to enforce opt-in semantics

The _TransportPortMeta metaclass and assert_transport_conforms() runtime guard must remain byte-unchanged and load-bearing; static mypy checking is a complement, not a replacement, for the runtime conformance audit and isinstance check

A static guard test must fail if a port parameter is left bare, annotated Any, or annotated through the unresolvable rebar_reconciler shim path, to prevent future ratchet promotions from silently reintroducing the blindness

All [attr-defined] errors produced by annotating the transport parameters must be resolved by declaring the member on TicketTransport (genuinely always required) or narrowing to a capability view (opt-in), never by reverting to Any or the shim import
The plan requires both annotation AND import-path repair; annotating alone without fixing the import path leaves enforcement silently degraded, indistinguishable in review from the real thing
